All original zero-pageerror assertions pass in the listed runs. Historical failed/rate-limited/transport diagnostic invocations remain separate. Mobile widths do not certify physical devices, software keyboards, installation or push. No production or external provider sends. Owned retained records archived, test accounts disabled and sessions revoked.
